map.输入基准音 A4 频率，按十二平均律计算钢琴全部 88 键音名对应频率。: Enter the reference A4 frequency to compute the frequency of all 88 piano keys by equal temperament.
map.基于十二平均律，以 A4=440Hz 为基准，第 n 个半音频率 f=440×2: Based on equal temperament, with A4=440 Hz as reference, the nth semitone frequency f = 440 × 2^((n−49)/12), for instrument pitch-to-frequency conversion.
map.💡 十二平均律公式：f = A4 × 2^((n-49)/12)，其中 n 为钢: 💡 Equal-temperament formula: f = A4 × 2^((n−49)/12), where n is the piano key number (A0=1, A4=49, C8=88). Adjacent semitone ratio 2^(1/12)≈1.0595.
map.标准音 A4 国际默认 440Hz，部分乐团使用 442Hz 或 443Hz: Standard A4 defaults to 440 Hz internationally; some ensembles use 442 Hz or 443 Hz.
map.橙色行为 A 音（基准音及其八度），紫色行为 C 音: Orange rows are A notes (reference and its octaves); purple rows are C notes.
map.本工具为理论频率，实际调音需考虑律制与琴弦谐振偏差: This tool gives theoretical frequencies; real tuning must account for temperament and string-resonance deviation.
map.📚 深度解析：乐器调音频率计算（十二平均律）: 📚 Deep Dive: Musical Tuning Frequency (equal temperament)
map.乐器调音：以 A4=440Hz 为基准，算任意音名频率: Instrument tuning: with A4=440 Hz as reference, compute any note frequency.
map.转调/移调：各音高按半音比 2^(1/12) 推算: Transposition: each pitch derived by the semitone ratio 2^(1/12).
map.教学演示：展示 88 键标准音域: Teaching demo: display the 88-key standard range.
map.算法（十二平均律）：f(n) = A4 × 2^((n−49)/12)，n 为音: Algorithm (equal temperament): f(n) = A4 × 2^((n−49)/12), n is the key number (49=A4); each semitone ratio 2^(1/12)≈1.05946, each octave ×2.
map.例：基准 A4=440Hz → 中央 C（C4，n=40）261.63Hz、A5: Example: reference A4=440 Hz → middle C (C4, n=40) 261.63 Hz, A5 (n=61) 880 Hz (exactly an A4 octave). If reference A4 is set to 442 Hz, all notes shift up about 0.8% for a different temperament / ensemble.
map.把八度（频率×2）均分 12 个半音，故每半音乘 2^(1/12)，可近似满足各: Dividing the octave (frequency ×2) into 12 equal semitones means each semitone multiplies by 2^(1/12), approximately satisfying the harmony of various chords.
map.国际通用 ISO 440Hz 为基准；部分古乐/地区用 415、442 等，须统: The international ISO 440 Hz is the reference; some early music / regions use 415, 442, etc.; unify the reference before deriving.
map.关于「乐器调音频率计算」: About the Musical Tuning Frequency Calculator
map.乐器调音频率计算器基于十二平均律，以 A4 基准音为参照，计算钢琴全部 88 键: The musical tuning frequency calculator is based on equal temperament, using A4 as reference, and computes the note names and frequencies of all 88 piano keys (A0 to C8), suitable for instrument tuning, acoustic calibration, and music-theory study.
map.支持自定义 A4 基准频率（440/442/443Hz 等）: Supports custom A4 reference (440 / 442 / 443 Hz, etc.)
map.输出全部 88 键音名与精确频率: Output all 88 key names and exact frequencies
map.标注中央 C 与基准音位置: Mark middle C and the reference note
